Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly synthesized the search results in its first response. While the search results clearly indicated that Princess Augusta of Waldeck-Pyrmont was the daughter of George II, the WebSurfer hallucinated a specific name ("Princess Christiane Henriette of Nassau-Siegen") as the mother of George II. This name was not present in the visible text of the search results (which mentioned "Princess Emma of Anhalt-Bernburg-Schaumburg-Hoym" in the EverybodyWiki snippet and implied George II's mother was Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen in the Wikipedia snippet). The agent failed to accurately extract the information from the provided text and instead invented a conflicting name, leading to a chain of redundant searches to verify a false premise.
